Facts of the case, in brief, are that one Pran Bollav Sarker as plaintiff filed Title suit No. 143 of 1969 in the First Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka, praying for declaration of title and further declaration that the ex parte decree dated 13.09.1967 passed by the same Court in Title Suit No. 166 of 1966 is void, illegal, fraudulent, inoperative and has no legal effect.
